# The All Day Market

> The All Day Market installs and operates free, fully managed self-serve smart markets (also known as micro markets, smart coolers, or a modern alternative to traditional vending machines) for businesses and properties across the Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW) area in Texas.

## Services
- Free, fully managed smart market / micro market installation — no cost to the property
- Stocking and restocking of snacks, drinks, and grab-and-go food, informed by sales data
- Remote monitoring and 24/7 support for market maintenance
- Cashless, unattended, 24/7 self-serve shopping via card or mobile wallet

## Service area
Dallas, Fort Worth, and surrounding DFW-area properties.

## Who it's for
Apartments, gyms and sports facilities, offices and workplaces, medical facilities, schools and universities, and hotels — any property with roughly 150+ people onsite daily.
